subject.title: Settings: add unified usage and spend dashboard

question: Should Usage & Spend remain a dedicated Settings pane, move into the existing Overview, or pause until its aggregation model is consolidated with https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2112?
rationale: The patch is technically well-supported, but repository vision and the contributor discussion explicitly reserve permanent product-surface placement for maintainer judgment.

options.title: Keep the dedicated pane
options.body: Approve the current cross-provider exploration surface and define its aggregation model as the reusable contract for future sharing features.

options.title: Integrate with Overview
options.body: Rework the presentation into the existing Overview to reduce the number of permanent Settings destinations.

options.title: Consolidate before landing
options.body: Pause both related PRs until their subscription, currency, coverage, and provenance models share a common implementation boundary.

recommendation.title: Keep the dedicated pane
recommendation.body: Approve the current cross-provider exploration surface and define its aggregation model as the reusable contract for future sharing features.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the current implementation and was directly asked for the product-placement decision.
